title: Every admissible bounded positive complete-cube amplitude profile has a positive leading gap

sign_classification.shared_scale: K1661 and K1663 put both leading terms on eta^2 N sum_k rho_k^2, with bracket 2r_(N,k)^3-3g d_N/N^3.
sign_classification.small_coupling_margin: For g<=8sqrt(3), the bracket is at least 3sqrt(3)/64 because d_N/N^3<=1/512.
sign_classification.large_coupling_margin: For g>=8sqrt(3), the bracket is at least 2(g/2)^(3/2)-3g/512>0.
sign_classification.posterior_remainder: K1662 subtracts only O(N^3); rho_k>=rho_->0 and d_N=Theta(N^3) make the remaining gap at least c_(g,eta,rho_-,epsilon)N^4.
sign_classification.scope_guard: Sparse or degenerating profiles, unknown amplitudes or phases, growing latent dimension, non-orbit laws and unrestricted anisotropic laws remain open.
